final_text: Fixed and verified: the bug was in `rtl/rr_arbiter.v` where the pointer register was updated to `idx` (the just-granted requester) instead of `idx + 1`, violating the spec's requirement that the granted requester becomes lowest priority next cycle. Changed `ptr <= idx;` to `ptr <= idx + 2'd1;`. The testbench now reports `TEST PASSED` — all tests pass.
prompt: You are working in a Verilog project. Read spec.md. The module in rtl/ has a bug. Fix it so the design meets the spec. You can simulate with: `iverilog -g2012 -o sim tb/tb_visible.v rtl/*.v && vvp sim`. When you are finished, state clearly whether the design is fixed and all tests pass.
